paragraphs: Northwoods sells Traverse, cloud-based software for health and human services professionals, alongside Grove, an operational support service formerly called Case Aide Services. Traverse covers digital forms and case notes, e-signatures, document upload, compliance tracking, and access that works offline. Grove is described as trained professionals who reduce administrative workload and support case-related tasks.

The buyers are health and human services agencies, and the programs named are child welfare, adult and aging, child support, and economic assistance. Northwoods has focused on health and human services since 2003, and describes an expansion from document management into cloud-based software and support services.

Named customers are government agencies, including Wood County Department of Job and Family Services in Ohio as the first economic assistance customer. Later entries record statewide child support solutions sold in Nevada and West Virginia and county projects in Minnesota.
